Petty Officer, H.M.S. "Keppel", Hong Kong, on the subject of one

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
Petty Officers Mess No. S. B. D. 3126.
H.M.S. "KEPPEL", 22. 1. 32.

January 12th, 1932. Hong Kong.

（左侧批注：No record in room 325. 24/32. N.P.）

Dear Sir,
I am taking the liberty of writing to you and asking if you could give me any information concerning a brother of mine, namely J.A. Gamblin.

I have made enquiries at the headquarters of the Police Department here, and have learned that he stowed away on a ship from Port Darwin to Hong Kong, was arrested on arrival and served a month in jail here. On being discharged he apparently frequented the water front here in the company of seafaring chaps and the police have not seen any more of him now for about ten weeks. It is supposed that he has jumped a ship and made his way either to Shanghai or to the States, so if he has come your way I should feel very much obliged if you would let him know that I am enquiring for him, and would be pleased to hear from him.

Trusting I am not putting you to too much bother.

I remain,
Yours Truly,
Wm Gamblin. R.C.

J.S. Morris
S.B.R. 22/1

$2, For attention please

刑事与特别分支登记科
海军准尉食堂 编号 S. B. D. 3126。
英国皇家海军“基帕尔”号，1932年1月22日。

1932年1月12日。香港。

（左侧批注：325室无记录。24/32。N.P.）

尊敬的先生：
冒昧致信，恳请阁下提供有关我兄弟 J.A. Gamblin 的任何信息。

我已向本地警察总局查询，获悉他作为偷渡者从达尔文港乘船抵达香港，抵港后被捕，并在本地服刑一个月。获释后，他显然常与水手们混迹于本地码头区域，警方已有约十周未见其踪影。据推测，他已跳船潜逃，前往上海或美国。因此，若他来到贵处，如蒙告知我正在寻找他，并让他与我联系，我将不胜感激。

相信未给阁下增添过多麻烦。

此致
敬礼，
Wm Gamblin. R.C.

J.S. Morris
特别分支登记处 22/1

$2，请予关注
M
1932年1月22日
